tags.title: Spark micro-batch throughput and end-to-end ingest lag
tags.concept: Operational analytics over pipeline telemetry; percentiles of batch duration
tags.question: How fast does Spark Structured Streaming process Kafka records, and how far behind does it run?
tags.interpretation: Lag = batch commit time - Kafka record timestamp (queueing + trigger interval + processing). rows_per_sec is per micro-batch (input rows / batch duration), measured, single-node local[4] Spark.
